headlines.description: — Jordan Staal returned from injury, Andrei Svechnikov and Mark Jankowski each scored twice and the Carolina Hurricanes beat the Seattle Kraken 5-1 on Saturday to sweep the NHL’s Global Series in Finland’s capital.
headlines.shortLinkText: Svechnikov and Jankowski each score twice, Carolina beats Kraken 5-1 to sweep series in Finland

headlines.description: — Mark Scheifele had a goal and three assists, Kyle Connor scored a goal in regulation and had the deciding shootout goal, and the Winnipeg Jets rallied from a four-goal deficit to beat the Chicago Blackhawks 5-4 on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Scheifele and Connor score in shootout and Jets erase 4-goal deficit for 5-4 win over Blackhawks

headlines.description: — Ryan Hartman and Danila Yurov scored two goals each, Jesper Wallstedt stopped 30 shots, and the Minnesota Wild beat the Boston Bruins 6-2 on Saturday night to extend their road winning streak to eight games.
headlines.shortLinkText: Wild beat Bruins 6-2 behind two goals from Ryan Hartman, extending road winning streak to 8 games

events.name: Edmonton Oilers at Toronto Maple Leafs

headlines.description: — Connor McDavid extended his season-opening points streak to 21 games with an assist, Devon Levi made 19 saves for his first NHL shutout and the Edmonton Oilers beat Toronto 1-0 on Saturday night to hand the Maple Leafs their sixth straight home loss.
headlines.shortLinkText: McDavid extends season-opening points streak to 21 games, Oilers beat Maple Leafs 1-0

headlines.description: — Artturi Lehkonen had a goal and an assist and the short-handed Colorado Avalanche beat the Montreal Canadiens 4-1 on Saturday night without injured stars Nathan MacKinnon and Cale Makar.
headlines.shortLinkText: Avalanche beat Canadiens 4-1 without injured stars MacKinnon, Makar

events.name: Detroit Red Wings at Tampa Bay Lightning

headlines.description: — Daniil Tarasov stopped 31 shots for his second shutout of the season, Lucas Raymond had a goal and two points and the Detroit Red Wings beat the Tampa Bay Lightning 2-0 on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Tarasov gets shutout, Raymond has 2 points as Red Wings defeat Lightning 2-0

headlines.description: — Claude Giroux scored a goal and the Ottawa Senators beat the Pittsburgh Penguins 4-1 on Saturday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Giroux, Stutzle score as Senators top Penguins, 4-1

events.name: New Jersey Devils at Washington Capitals

headlines.description: — Connor Hellebuyck recovered from a shaky start to make 43 saves, remaining unbeaten in net with New Jersey as the surging Devils defeated the Washington Capitals 7-4 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Connor Hellebuyck makes 43 saves and improves to 7-0 with Devils in 7-4 win over Capitals

events.name: Philadelphia Flyers at Columbus Blue Jackets

headlines.description: — Denver Barkey scored twice and the Philadelphia Flyers rallied to beat Columbus 4-3 on Saturday night, sending the Blue Jackets to their fourth consecutive loss and third straight at home.
headlines.shortLinkText: Barkey scores twice as Flyers rally past Blue Jackets, 4-3

events.name: Florida Panthers at St. Louis Blues

headlines.description: — Brady and Matthew Tkachuk participated in a pregame ceremony to honor their father, then led the Florida Panthers to a 4-1 win over the St. Louis Blues on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Tkachuk brothers power Panthers to 4-1 win after Hall of Fame father honored by Blues

headlines.description: — Jake Oettinger made 22 saves to lead the Dallas Stars to a 2-0 win over the Buffalo Sabres on Saturday night, just two days after being pulled after allowing a season-high six goals.
headlines.shortLinkText: Oettinger makes 22 saves as the Stars beat the Sabres 2-0

events.name: San Jose Sharks at Utah Mammoth

headlines.description: — Mason Marchment flicked in a wrist shot in the fifth round of a shootout to lift the San Jose Sharks to a 6-5 win over the Utah Mammoth on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Marchment lifts Sharks to shootout win over Mammoth

events.name: New York Islanders at Anaheim Ducks

headlines.description: — Simon Holmstrom had his first career hat trick, Matthew Schaefer added three assists and the New York Islanders rolled to a 6-2 victory over the Anaheim Ducks on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Simon Holmstrom has first hat trick in Islanders' 6-2 win over Ducks 6-2

events.name: Calgary Flames at Los Angeles Kings

headlines.description: — Matvei Gridin scored the go-ahead goal with 8:39 remaining and the Calgary Flames held off the Los Angeles Kings 3-2 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Sharangovich and Wolf help the Flames hold off the Kings for a 3-2 win
